subject: Fix assertion crash in processIOThreadsReadDone when DONT_PARSE client has stale argc (#3245)
reason: The fix removes an assertion crash in processIOThreadsReadDone that only occurs under a precise IO-thread race: a client with a stale argc from a partial parse must have close_after_reply set between reads (so the next offloaded read carries READ_FLAGS_DONT_PARSE) and then receive more bytes. The only deterministic way to set that flag at the right instant is the DEBUG SET-CLOSE-AFTER-REPLY subcommand this same PR adds, fired from a separate control connection against the victim's captured client ID and synchronized on tot-net-in byte counts. That subcommand exists only on the fixed build, not
